segments.text: Welcome, boys and girls! It’s our Science Day. We have Mr Qian with us to talk about some new inventions.
Hi, I’ve got some interesting things to tell you today. Look, this invention is very useful. You pour in sea water and let the sun do the work for a few hours. Then you have clean fresh water!
Look, these are also great inventions from Chinese scientists. In 2019, they explored the “dark” side of the moon.
They took amazing photos and sent them back.
Yes. We know so little about that part of the moon and it’s important to find out more.
The wheel is an old invention. It dates back to over 5,000 years ago.

Now we can find wheels almost everywhere around us. For example, there are wheels at home, in the street and in the classroom. We can find wheels in a clock, an electric fan, a juicer and a washing machine. We can find wheels on a bus, a bike, a train and an airplane. Sometimes we can also find wheels on chairs or desks.
The wheel is one of the most important inventions. Wheels make housework much easier. Wheels help people travel around easily and comfortably. And wheels help people carry heavy things.
Thanks to the wheel, we are able to save time and work to make more inventions.
